what: ESLint found an assignment to a variable declared with const.

street.headline: You try change `{1}`, but you mark am as `const`
street.happen: `{1}` na `const`. Once you assign am, you no fit assign another value.
street.todo: If e need to change, use `let`:
street.learn: `const` mean say the binding no dey change.

normal.headline: `{1}` na `const`, so you no fit reassign am
normal.happen: `{1}` was declared with `const`. A `const` binding cannot be reassigned after it is created.
normal.todo: If e need to change, use `let`:
normal.learn: `const` mean say the binding no dey change.
